findings.problem: implement-spec doesn't take a hand-picked set of Tickets. It is given one Spec and builds all of that Spec's Tickets in one run, on one integration branch. This lesson itself suggests one Spec per feature for the rebuild, so "three of the rebuild's Tickets" may belong to different Specs, which one `/implement-spec` run can't cover. The site's implement-spec lesson frames it as "build a whole Spec in one run" and says "implement-spec is for a whole Spec's Tickets", so the two lessons describe it differently.
